Read fitted binding curves

Source: R/read.R
read_mst_fit_curve.Rd

Reads the curves MO.Affinity Analysis fitted to each merge set, from the Fit-Values sheet of Compare Results (Chart) and Dose-Response (Grouped) exports.

Usage

read_mst_fit_curve(path)

Arguments

path

Path to an .xlsx file exported from MO.Affinity Analysis, or a .moc or .nta project file.

Value

A tibble with one row per point on each curve, with columns series, merge_set, target, ligand_concentration, fnorm, response_type and response. response is the curve in the units the data was exported in (see response_type); fnorm is the same curve as Fnorm. Some exports leave the curves empty, giving a tibble with no rows.

Examples

read_mst_fit_curve(tidymst_example("dsnppr10_compare-delta-fnorm.xlsx"))
#> # A tibble: 300 × 7
#>    series merge_set     target ligand_concentration fnorm response_type response
